form_g.title: Phoneme Gestures for Early Education

/b/.gesture: Bounce a ball with both hands

/k/.gesture: Pretend to crack an egg open

/d/.gesture: Tap fingers like playing a drum

/g/.gesture: Pull down a pretend goat beard

/j/.gesture: Pretend to spread jam on bread

/l/.gesture: Move hand in a flowing wave (like licking lips)

/n/.gesture: Wiggle fingers downward like net catching fish

/p/.gesture: Clap hands softly like popping bubbles

/r/.gesture: Wiggle fingers near mouth like whiskers

/s/.gesture: Trace a spiral sun in the air

/t/.gesture: Tap index finger on the palm of other hand

/y/.gesture: Nod head and give thumbs up

/z/.gesture: Wiggle index fingers like a buzzing bee

/a/.gesture: Pretend to take a bite of an apple

/e/.gesture: Make an elephant trunk with arm

/u/.gesture: Pretend to open an umbrella overhead

/ā/.gesture: Draw a straight line across air (like a cake slice)

/ī/.gesture: Trace a kite shape in the air

/ū/.gesture: Pretend to blow out a birthday candle (small puff sound)

/ch/.gesture: Pretend to chop with side of hand

/wh/.gesture: Move hand in a swimming motion

/ng/.gesture: Pretend to sing (open mouth, hand to ear)

implementation_tips: Always say the sound aloud as you do the gesture
Use gestures during spelling dictation, sound review, and handwriting warm-ups
Keep gestures consistent across all phonics lessons
Encourage students to mirror the gesture when you say the sound
